age.evidence: Adult male C57BL/6J mice aged 10 weeks were sourced from Beijing SPF Biotechnology Co., Ltd.... Prior to undergoing fear conditioning, the mice were allowed to acclimate to standard conditions for a period of 2 weeks.

sex.evidence: Adult male C57BL/6J mice aged 10 weeks... Forty-eight C57BL/6J mice were randomly divided into three groups (n = 16 in each group)

dosing.doses_raw: 2.5 mg/kg (pilot trials also tested 0.1, 0.5, and 2.5 mg/kg)
dosing.evidence: Psilocybin was dissolved in physiological saline to prepare a solution for intraperitoneal injection... During our initial trials, a range of doses for psilocybin was tested, including 0.1, 0.5, and 2.5 mg/kg. Upon evaluation, the most effective dose was determined to be 2.5 mg/kg. Each group was administered either physiological saline or psilocybin at a dosage of 2.5 mg/kg via intraperitoneal injection.

handling.evidence: not reported; only 'The study protocol, including the care and handling of the mice, was approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee' (no handling protocol described)

group_housing.evidence: The mice were housed in plastic enclosures with ad libitum access to water and food. (cage density not stated)

day_night_flipped.evidence: The housing environment was maintained on a 12-hour light-dark cycle, with lights on from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM... Behavioral testing was conducted between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM

assays.assay_name: Auditory-cued fear conditioning / fear memory test
assays.assay_description: Mice conditioned on D-2 in context A (transparent acrylic chamber; 120-s adaptation, five 30-s 80 dB 5 kHz tones co-terminating with 0.8 mA 2-s footshocks, 120-s ITI; 14.5 min total). Single psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg i.p.) or saline on D0. Fear memory tested without shock on D1 and D6 in context B (triangular black/white chamber) and D7 in context A, 4 CS trials with 30-s ITI; outcome = % freezing across total CS duration (120 s), scored by automated motion-detection video system.

application_type.evidence: Each group was administered either physiological saline or psilocybin at a dosage of 2.5 mg/kg via intraperitoneal injection.

setup_habituation.evidence: The only pre-exposure described is the 120-s adaptation within the conditioning session ('the mice were initially introduced to context A for a 120-second adaptation and exploration phase'), which is part of a recorded session, not a separate habituation; no habituation to context B described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were placed in context B and presented with four CS trials; freezing defined as 'complete cessation of all movement except respiration and heartbeat' (animal free to move).

food_restriction.evidence: Chambers described only as fitted with shock and tone devices with stainless-steel grid and tray; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Chambers described only as fitted with shock and tone devices with stainless-steel grid and tray; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: an auditory cue-based fear memory test was conducted 24 hours post-administration... On the first (D1) and sixth (D6) days after administration, mice were placed in context B... On the seventh day (D7), mice were tested in context A

sample_size.evidence: Forty-eight C57BL/6J mice were randomly divided into three groups (n = 16 in each group)... n = 16 mice/group

outcomes.summary: A single dose of psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg i.p.) given after auditory-cued fear conditioning significantly reduced CS-evoked freezing relative to fear-conditioned vehicle mice on D1 and D6 (context B, cued fear) and D7 (context A, combined contextual + cued fear). Baseline and post-conditioning freezing did not differ between FC(+) groups before treatment.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin reduced the cue-induced fear response on days 1, 6, and 7... These results demonstrate that psilocybin produces a rapid and lasting reduction in both auditory-cued fear and combined contextual/cued fear memory.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The primary dependent variable was the percentage of freezing time relative to the total duration of CS presentation (4 trials × 30 seconds).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The present study utilized aggregate freezing data across entire test sessions.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: not reported; only aggregate freezing percentage analysed

B4_ethological.evidence: Freezing behavior was defined as the complete cessation of all movement except respiration and heartbeat, serving as a measure of the fear response (conditioned freezing).

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually in fear conditioning chambers; no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: This study utilized the fear conditioning paradigm... Fear memory was assessed by the percentage of freezing time in response to conditioned stimuli.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Freezing time was recorded and analyzed using an FC video analysis system... The automated system quantified freezing via frame-by-frame motion detection algorithms (motion threshold, not ML behavioural classification).

B8_multivariate.evidence: data were analyzed by one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) followed by Dunnett's multiple comparisons test

E1_environment_type.evidence: context A, a transparent acrylic chamber, and context B, a triangular chamber crafted from opaque black and white acrylic

E2_shelter.evidence: definitionally absent; no shelter/refuge in fear conditioning chambers

E3_bedding.evidence: the stainless-steel grid and tray were wiped with 75% alcohol (context A) or 0.5% acetic acid (context B)

E4_nesting.evidence: definitionally absent; no nesting material in chambers

E5_enrichment.evidence: definitionally absent; no enrichment objects in chambers

E6_spatial.evidence: Each context is a single chamber (context A transparent acrylic chamber; context B triangular chamber); two contexts are separate apparatuses, not compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: After each mouse was tested, their excrement was removed... (mice tested individually)

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the testing chambers.

D1_continuity.evidence: Fear memory tests were conducted on days 1, 6, and 7; conditioning-day freezing (D-2) also reported.

D2_session_duration.evidence: The entire fear conditioning process lasted 14.5 minutes; test sessions comprised four 30-s CS trials separated by 30-s ITIs.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Freezing data reported for D-2 (conditioning), D1, D6, and D7 = 4 days.

D4_baseline.evidence: On the day of fear conditioning, the percentage of freezing time during the first sound period was defined as the baseline freezing time... (F (2, 45) = 0.536, p = 0.590) — recorded on D-2, before D0 drug administration.

D5_followup.evidence: Six days following a single psilocybin dose, mice showed a significant reduction in freezing time; D7 also tested.

assays.assay_description: Locomotor control test on D1, 2 h before the fear memory test (~22 h post-dose). Mice placed in centre of 40×40×40 cm arena (16 virtual regions); after 2-min acclimation, total distance travelled recorded for 5 min with Smart 3.0 (Panlab) video tracking.

application_type.evidence: Each group was administered either physiological saline or psilocybin at a dosage of 2.5 mg/kg via intraperitoneal injection.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only 'Following an initial 2-minute acclimation period' within the test session itself is described; no separate prior apparatus exposure.

setup_restrain.evidence: The mice were positioned at the center of the open field arena... and permitted to roam freely.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the open field arena.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the open field arena.

time_to_assay.evidence: The OFT was performed on D1, 2 hours prior to the fear memory test; the fear memory test was conducted 24 hours post-administration.

sample_size.evidence: we conducted the OFT 2 hours before the fear test to evaluate the activity of the three groups of mice... n = 16 mice/group

outcomes.summary: Total distance travelled in the open field did not differ among FC(-) Veh, FC(+) Veh and FC(+) PSI groups, indicating psilocybin (2.5 mg/kg, ~1 day earlier) did not alter locomotor activity.
outcomes.evidence: One-way ANOVA revealed no significant difference in the total distance traveled among the three groups (F (2, 45) = 2.078, p = 0.137; Figure 1(d)), indicating that neither fear conditioning nor psilocybin administration affected the activity of the mice.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Locomotor activity was assessed by measuring the total distance traveled.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: the tracking system captured and analyzed the distance covered by the mice during the subsequent 5-minute interval (single total)

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: not reported; only total distance measured

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually in the open field.

B6_cognitive.evidence: OFT measures locomotor activity, not learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: using an advanced video tracking system (Smart version 3.0; Panlab, Barcelona, Spain) — position tracking only.

E1_environment_type.evidence: open field arena (40 cm × 40 cm × 40 cm), which was sectioned into 16 equivalent regions

E2_shelter.evidence: definitionally absent; no shelter in open field

E3_bedding.evidence: not reported; no bedding described in arena

E6_spatial.evidence: sectioned into 16 equivalent regions (virtual zones, not physical compartments)

E7_social_context.evidence: The mice were positioned at the center of the open field arena... permitted to roam freely (individual testing).

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the arena.

D1_continuity.evidence: The OFT was performed on D1, 2 hours prior to the fear memory test.

D3_recording_days.evidence: The OFT was performed on D1.

D5_followup.evidence: OFT performed on D1, 2 h before the 24-h fear test (~22 h post-dose, <24 h).

judge_notes: Two behavioural assays retained (fear conditioning/memory test; OFT); all three candidates agreed. Golgi, Western blot, DCX immunofluorescence excluded as non-behavioural.
Fear conditioning acquisition (D-2) and memory tests on D1/D6/D7 in contexts A and B collapsed into one assay per rubric.
Corrected gemma's B1 score (1 measure = 0 points) and E6 (separate single-chamber contexts are not multi-compartment apparatus).
D4 baseline = Yes for fear assay (2 of 3 candidates): first-CS freezing on conditioning day D-2 recorded before D0 drug administration.

setup_habituation overridden to not_reported for both assays: the 120-s adaptation is part of the recorded conditioning session and the OFT 2-min acclimation is within the test session, which the rubric excludes.
OFT time_to_assay set to 1320 min (2 h before the 24-h fear test); D5 = 0 since <24 h, though figure caption loosely states '24 hours prior'.
Dosing lists only 2.5 mg/kg used in experiments; 0.1 and 0.5 mg/kg were pilot doses with no data reported here.
Age: 10 weeks at sourcing plus 2-week acclimation, so range 70–84 days.
